subject: Draft MAP: POC infra checklist & owner confirmations (target Oct 28)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Park <sophie@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP: POC infra checklist & owner confirmations (target Oct 28)

Hi Sophie — thanks again for the discovery call this morning. I put together a short draft MAP focused on the POC environment readiness items we discussed so we can lock owners and dates. Quick summary below; attached is the MAP spreadsheet (MAP-Acme-POC-v0.1.xlsx) and the VPN diagram you referenced.

POC milestone: Redwood-hosted POC running on Acme staging VPC (target POC demo week: 2026-10-28)
- Milestone 1 — VPC peering & routing: target complete by 2026-10-20. Owner: TBD (please confirm Acme infra owner). Dependencies: route table updates, firewall rules.
- Milestone 2 — IP allowlist / egress rules: target complete by 2026-10-20. Owner: Acme network/security. Dependency: public IPs for Redwood test nodes (we'll provide).
- Milestone 3 — SSO / SAML integration: target complete by 2026-10-22. Owner: Acme SSO admin. Dependency: metadata file / IdP cert exchange.
- Milestone 4 — Secrets & KMS access: target complete by 2026-10-22. Owner: Acme security. Dependency: service-account IAM role + KMS policy review.

Action items we need from Acme to finalize the MAP:
1) Confirm owners for VPC peering and SSO (name + email).
2) Provide current VPC CIDR + preferred peering / transit setup.
3) Confirm whether Acme will provide a customer-managed KMS key or if you prefer Redwood KMS proxy.
4) Agree on dates above or propose adjustments.

Proposed next steps: please confirm owners by end of day Monday (2026-10-12). If that works I'll schedule a 30-min technical kickoff with our infra engineer (Stephanie) and your infra lead to walk through routing and KMS access.

Attachments: MAP-Acme-POC-v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet), acme-vpn-diagram.png

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Draft MAP: POC infra checklist & owner confirmations (target Oct 28)

Karthik — thanks for the clear write-up and the MAP draft. High level looks good and the dates are realistic for our team. Ownership notes below:
- VPC peering & routing: Tom Riley (tom.riley@acme-retail.com) will own this and coordinate with your infra team.
- IP allowlist / firewall changes: Acme network team (infra-eng@acme-retail.com) — I'll loop them on the kickoff.
- SSO / SAML: Priya Shah (priya.shah@acme-retail.com) — she'll handle IdP metadata and cert exchange.
- KMS / secrets: I'll have security review. We prefer to use our customer-managed KMS key; I expect a short procurement step for the key policy (shouldn't block the timeline but will confirm by Wednesday).

Can you share the exact public IPs and the CIDR block you need whitelisted for the test nodes? Also include the service-account email for KMS IAM. We'll aim to confirm final owners and provide the CIDR by 2026-10-12 as requested.

Happy to do the technical kickoff on 2026-10-13 or 2026-10-14 — please send a calendar invite with Stephanie and Tom.

Best,
Sophie Park
Director, Cloud Infrastructure
Acme Retail
